summary: KRISHINITI is an AI-powered agricultural platform that uses NASA satellite data, weather information and geographical insights to help farmers make better farming decisions. Farmers can select their land on an interactive map and get suitable crop recommendations, crop rotation plans, soil improvement guidance, weather updates and nearby mandi information. Our goal is to make modern space technology useful and accessible to farmers for sustainable and profitable agriculture.
details:
1. What does it do or how does it work?

KRISHINITI helps farmers make better decisions about their land and crops. Farmers can select their land on the map and get a farm report based on satellite data, weather information and geographical conditions. It provides suitable crop recommendations, crop rotation plans, soil improvement guidance, weather alerts and nearby mandi information.

2. What benefits does it have?

It helps farmers choose suitable crops, reduce farming risks, improve soil health, plan crop rotations and use available resources wisely. It also helps them find nearby mandis to explore better selling opportunities.

3. What is the intended impact of the project?

Our aim is to make modern space technology useful for ordinary farmers, especially those who do not have access to advanced agricultural information. We want to support sustainable farming, better crop planning, reduced crop losses and improve farmer livelihood.

4. What tools, coding languages, hardware or software did you use?

We used HTML, CSS and JavaScript for the website Node.js and Express.js for the backend, Leaflet for interactive maps and Google Maps services for geographical features. We also integrated NASA Earth observation data, weather data, AI APIs and other online data sources. The project was developed using VS Code and tested on a computer. No special hardware was required.

5. How is your project creative?

The main idea is to turn complex and scattered satellite and environmental data into simple, useful farming advice. Instead of just showing weather or satellite images KRISHINITI connects land analysis with crop recommendations, crop rotation, soil improvement and market information in one platform.

6. What factors did your team consider?

We considered soil conditions, land location, weather, temperature, rainfall, water availability, existing cropping patterns, crop suitability, soil health and market access. We also focused on making the platform simple, affordable and accessible to farmers, including those who prefer using Hindi.
